<code><nowiki>{{ClassLink}}</nowiki></code> renders a link to a class page. The ordinary positional page-title form is the supported first-class form:

<pre>{{ClassLink|Windblade}}</pre>

The positional page title supplies the destination and the visible text. Use explicit presentation fields when they differ:

<pre>{{ClassLink
 |Windblade
 |link=Windblade
 |text=the Windblade class
}}</pre>

The link picker may supply <code>stablekey</code>. This is the exact advanced class identity selected by the picker. It distinguishes a class record from its display name. Editors normally do not need to memorize or type it. A stable-key-only form is intended for generated links:

<pre>{{ClassLink|stablekey=class:duelist}}</pre>

== Parameters ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter
! Description
|-
| <code>1</code>
| Class page and default display text. The first positional page-title parameter is the usual form.
|-
| <code>stablekey</code>
| Exact advanced class identity selected automatically by the Erenshor link picker. Usually leave this to generated links.
|-
| <code>link</code> or <code>page</code>
| Explicit destination page.
|-
| <code>text</code>
| Visible link text.
|}
